issues.issue: The open row menu on 'Ram Create Clips' overlays the Last viewed column, cutting 'Thur…', 'April' and 'March 16' mid-word in the rows behind it.
Duration values carry an unlabelled '+1' suffix ('01:26 +1', '01:36 +1') in the same column as plain values, so the column stops reading as one comparable number.
The destination rail on the right (Project, Properties, Elements, Captions, Stock, Underlord) is jammed against the window edge, and 'Underlord' plus the AI Tools description are clipped by it.

Three entry points stack before the Projects grid: the full-width cyan Create project hero, three equal tool cards, and a full-height Auto removal promo tile, so the grid starts below three competing first moves.
The Details panel leaves roughly 110px of dead space between 'Import material: Keep in original place' and the full-width grey 'Modify' button pinned to the panel floor.
The cyan 'AI' pill is attached to seven of the nine More tools tiles, so the badge marks almost everything and stops distinguishing anything.
Three raw identifiers (two UUIDs and 'composer-5gohk1eo6') print at body size directly under the tabs and above the 'Tracks' heading, so developer strings are the first content on the page.
'Create' and 'Ask Co-Creator' sit at equal size and weight in the header while 'Generate with AI' and 'Export all' sit at equal weight inside the panel, giving four competing actions.
The 'Sound Effects' control draws a white rounded border that overlaps the 'Music' label beside it and sits below the panel's tab underline, so the tab row has no single shape.
'Why this clip >' is a 13px text link in the same stack as Download MP4, SRT, VTT, Meta and Poster, so the reason for 35.7/40 is quieter than the export formats.
The style swatches wrap 4 + 3 with 'Custom' alone on a third row beneath the Impact/Clean/Pop/Cinema tabs, so the block reads as two broken grids rather than one.
'3. Transcribe' is the only stage row without a status word beside its name (1-2 read 'Done', 4-7 read 'Waiting on 3. Transcribe'), so the failed step is carried by the X icon and the red rule alone.
The view strip carries eight chips plus '5 more…', 'Filter' and 'Display' above the list, and the active 'Active' chip differs only by fill, so the chrome outweighs the rows.
Label pills truncate at roughly 90px ('Currency Support…', 'Frontend user d…', 'Develop…'), so no two rows' labels can be compared without opening them.
The panel tabs are 'Properties' as a word plus three unlabelled icons with no selected state, so three of the four destinations cannot be identified and the current one is not marked.
The eight-item left rail is icon-only with no labels and no selected state, so its destinations can only be guessed from the glyphs.

The Auto headline notice is set in a wide-tracked monospace face with 'Disable it' pushed to the far right of the last line, so the notice reads as log output and its action is detached from its sentence.
The preview toolbar puts six items on one line (9:16, Layout: Fill, B, crop icon, Color correction: OFF, Tracker: On) and 'Tracker: On' is clipped by the panel's right edge.

notes: Only P4 supplied an error screen, so empty/error is scored at full strength for P4 and from the surviving screens for the rest; no empty or loading state appears anywhere in the panel. Episode titles, clip copy and placeholder thumbnails are fixture content and were not scored.
